items.name: changelog
items.description: Write a CHANGELOG entry from a diff or a set of commits

items.name: code-review
items.description: Review a diff for bugs, style and missing tests

items.name: coding-kit
items.description: A coding harness as a whole agent directory: workspace tools with rewind, an allow-listed shell, permission rules, a loop guard, compaction, a fix-failing-test skill and a read-only explorer sub-agent

items.name: coding-pi
items.description: The coding-kit harness on the Pi provider stack: the lead agent runs on pi/openrouter and delegates implementation to a Pi coding-agent sub-agent (engine: 'pi') with its own permission rules

items.name: generic-webhook
items.description: Inbound webhook channel with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification (reads WEBHOOK_SECRET)

items.name: github-issues
items.description: List and create GitHub issues through api.github.com (reads GITHUB_TOKEN)

items.name: inbox-triage
items.description: A message-triage agent as a whole agent directory: file-backed inbox and outbox tools, a reply pipeline gated on human approval, an inbound webhook channel, a 15-minute poll schedule, per-sender memory and prompt-injection-aware instructions

items.name: incident-response
items.description: SRE incident-response agent directory: an HMAC-verified webhook channel for alert intake, simulated infrastructure tools gated by risk-tiered permission rules (read-only diagnostics allowed, staging remediation auto-allowed, production remediation asks, destructive data operations denied), a risk-tier annotating approver and an audit-timeline hook

items.name: open-meteo-weather
items.description: Current weather for a city through the Open-Meteo API (free, no API key)
